sentences.en: Many local traditions have fallen into decay in recent years.
sentences.zh: 近年来，许多地方的传统已经衰败。

sentences.en: Flies have a keen sense of smell for decaying matter.
sentences.zh: 苍蝇对腐烂物质有敏锐的嗅觉。

sentences.en: Dan carefully lifted the badly decayed body of the cat.
sentences.zh: 丹小心地抬起了那只严重腐烂的猫的身体。
